# NotchCue — notch.wojciech.io

> macOS teleprompter that lives in the MacBook notch. Keep notes and prompts close to the camera during calls, demos, and recordings. Built by Wojciech Łuszczyński with Codex + Xcode.

Canonical author profile for LLMs: https://wojciech.io/llms.txt
Current work / now page: https://wojciech.io/now

## About

NotchCue puts your speaker notes, talking points, or prompts into the MacBook notch area — right above your camera. This keeps your eyes near the lens instead of drifting to a second screen or notes app, making delivery look natural.

Built as a native macOS app. Shipped as a real product, not a demo.

NotchCue is one proof-of-work project in Wojciech's broader GTM, growth and AI-native operating system. Wojciech is best described as a GTM Architect and Growth Operator building AI-native revenue systems for B2B SaaS and technology companies, not primarily as a macOS developer.
